stage1_reconstruction: Archived Table-3 fracture scale plus Euclidean fixed-threshold connectivity, mathematically identical to the connected components obtained by cutting the Euclidean MST at that scale.
stage1_group_count_check: All 1000 realisations matched the archived Table-3 Stage-1 group count; the harness aborts on any mismatch.
s3_scope: Frozen S3 applied only to the Stage-1 parent shared by T01/T02; if Stage 1 already separated them, the Stage-1 partition is retained unchanged.
zero_error_baseline: Original archived Table-3 DeltaV=5 per-realisation results reused exactly; non-zero observational-error conditions rerun from the exact original intrinsic velocity field and target parent.
